files.coverage: Wayback Machine snapshot of 20240525015917 of https://mrvc.indianrailways.gov.in/works/uploads/File/1.Executive%20Summary_Volume%201%281%29.pdf (catalogue id mrvc_trespass_midsection_executive_summary), the original bytes as archived (the id_ flag); acquired because the publisher's host refuses this address (9.207).
